import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Start directly
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 &")
print("Started")
import time
time.sleep(8)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ps aux | grep 'node.*server/dist' | grep -v grep")
print("\n=== Processes ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\n=== Health ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:200])
client.close()
EOF
